exam.title: Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official exam guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice ANSI SQL, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, SQL warehouses, query diagnosis, AI/BI dashboards, Genie and Unity Catalog governance.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Understanding of Databricks Data + AI Platform
Executing queries using Databricks SQL and Databricks SQL Warehouses
Creating Dashboards and Visualizations in Databricks
Developing, Sharing, and Maintaining AI/BI Genie spaces

review.notes: The October 30, 2025 detailed PDF and live nine-domain weighted page were reconciled. Every objective maps to a platform, data, SQL, model, compute, evidence, sharing, identity, failure or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover Catalog Explorer/Marketplace/lineage; governed cleanup and intake; ANSI SQL, warehouses, joins/sets/aggregates/objects/federation/history; query profiles/Photon/cache/clustering; AI/BI dashboards, parameters, sharing, refresh and alerts; grounded Genie spaces, Trusted Assets, benchmarks and feedback; star/snowflake/Data Vault; and layered Unity Catalog security. All 27 guide URLs are cataloged: 26 reachable and the community forum automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The Academy course replacement is labeled as a learning-catalog transition, commercial freshness and duration boundaries are explicit, and vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced.

findings.title: Current product terminology and access model need precision
findings.evidence: Setup reference identifies former Genie Spaces name and separates author compute credentials from end-user data authorization.
findings.recommendation: Cross-reference Agents while preserving exam wording; add identity and warehouse requirements.
findings.resolution: Cross-reference Agents while preserving exam wording; add identity and warehouse requirements.

findings.title: Cleaning example erased identifier semantics
findings.evidence: The existing postal-code integer conversion could erase leading zeros and reject letters.
findings.recommendation: Keep postal codes as text and constrain TRY_CAST advice to genuinely numeric fields.
findings.resolution: Keep postal codes as text and constrain TRY_CAST advice to genuinely numeric fields.

findings.title: Dashboard publication identity was underspecified
findings.evidence: Published shared-data permissions use publisher data privileges; individual mode uses viewers; both share publisher compute access.
findings.recommendation: Add mode table and draft/published test cases.
findings.resolution: Add mode table and draft/published test cases.

findings.title: NULL and anti-join reasoning lacked worked cases
findings.evidence: Three-valued logic, aggregate treatment and NOT IN can change the analyzed population.
findings.recommendation: Add explained failures and locally checked relational cases.
findings.resolution: Add explained failures and locally checked relational cases.
